channel.title: Rustambek Urokov
channel.description: Undergraduate researcher in machine learning and computational biology at New Uzbekistan University. Held-out evaluation for protein and sequence models.

item.title: Deep dive into flow models
item.dc:creator: Rustambek Urokov
item.description: Flow models reach the data distribution with an ODE rather than an SDE. Velocity fields, marginal versus conditional, and why the two flow matching losses have the same minimiser.

item.title: What are diffusion models, and how exactly do they stand out from Autoregressive Models?
item.dc:creator: Rustambek Urokov
item.description: Autoregressive models generate left to right and pay for it in both accuracy and cost. What diffusion models do instead, and where each one actually wins.

item.title: We tried to beat Pfam for BGC retrieval. Pfam won.
item.dc:creator: Rustambek Urokov
item.description: A Set Transformer over frozen ESM-2 embeddings lost to plain Pfam-domain Jaccard on biosynthetic gene cluster retrieval. What a negative result says about baselines and evaluation.

item.title: Fine-tuning ESM-2 for protein subcellular localization: LoRA matches full fine-tuning with 2.4% of the parameters
item.dc:creator: Rustambek Urokov
item.description: Rank-16 LoRA on ESM-2 650M reaches the accuracy of a fully fine-tuned 150M model while training 2.4% of the weights — and a frozen 8M linear probe is already most of the way there.
